name: Verify Minimum TE
description: Reminds the operator to verify that the minimum available echo time is used. Always emits a warning showing the actual TE; the guidance text is configurable.
implementation:
te = value["EchoTime"].dropna()
if len(te) > 0:
    guidance = params.get("guidance") or ""
    raise ValidationWarning(f"Echo Time is {te.iloc[0]} ms. Verify this is the minimum TE available for your sequence. {guidance}".strip())

params.guidance: Minimum TE should always be used for ASL.

parameterDefinitions.name: guidance
parameterDefinitions.label: Guidance
parameterDefinitions.default: Longer TE causes T2/T2* decay and reduced SNR.
parameterDefinitions.description: Context appended to the warning (e.g. why minimum TE matters for this protocol)
